mechanism_predictor.note: frozen before evaluation; maps a registered structure type to the mechanism class the tranche predicts is required
mechanism_predictor.null: uniform random assignment of one of the five mechanism classes to each registered structure type, 200 trials

prospective_predictions.claim: all seven modes are defined as exact predicates and the pairwise distinctness table is complete: for every ordered pair of modes there is a registered task on which the first holds and the second fails

at least one registered mode is realized by NO member of the prediction-only classes L0, L1, L_lin, L_mod, proved by exhaustive enumeration, while an L_search learner at the registered depth realizes it exactly

the matched pair (T_MATCH_COMPOSITIONAL, T_MATCH_LOOKUP) has exactly equal Bayes predictive accuracy on the registered test distribution and strictly different exact accuracy on held-out recombinations
the matched pair (T_CODE_A, T_CODE_B) has exactly equal integer description length and strictly different exact transfer accuracy
the frozen mechanism predictor strictly beats the largest hit count attained by the 200-trial random null
no artifact of the package asserts MEMORY_GENERALIZATION_ANALOGY_REASONING_SAME_MECHANISM, and AE14-P2 is its machine-checked refutation at the registered scope

registered_constants.analogy_group: the cyclic group generated by the coordinate rotation (x0,x1,x2,x3) -> (x1,x2,x3,x0), order 4
registered_constants.code: Kraft-compliant prefix-free integer code over the registered model space, frozen as: 1 + 2*ceil(log2(index+2)) bits for the index-th model in the frozen model order
registered_constants.planning_primitives: p1 = add 1 mod 4 to block 1; p2 = exchange the two blocks
registered_constants.reasoning_rules: four Horn rules over six propositional atoms, frozen in the executor as REASON_RULES and reproduced in the receipt
